title.narrative: Client-Oriented Response for HIV Epidemic Control (CORE)

description.narrative: Reduce new HIV infections and HIV morbidity and mortality rates through increasing access to and utilization of high-quality, comprehensive services across the continuum of HIV treatment and care within the sub-national units (SNUs) or districts where it operates.
